name: The Last Traveller
summary: A young man in rags and beautiful boots sits at the edge of the mists on the Old Svalich Road, asking what day it is.

stages.journal: Ilarion, from the village under the castle, went into the fog last night to fetch a doctor for his wife's fever, and the fog turned him round. His clothes are rags many years old. His boots aren't.
objectives: Walk him down to the village
stages.hint: Walk Ilarion down the Old Svalich Road to the village.

stages.journal: The count's wolves came out of the fog for Ilarion as soon as he set off.
stages.hint: Get Ilarion past the wolves and on down the road.

stages.journal: Ilarion is walking home to the village. Everything there is wrong, and he keeps starting his sentences again.
objectives: Take him to the well in the Village of Barovia
stages.hint: Take Ilarion to the well in the village of Barovia's square.

stages.journal: Ilarion's night in the mists was fifty years. His daughter is Goodwife Petra, who carries the water, and his son is Old Mihail, who dug him a grave. He's home, younger than both of them.
